name: Gravity-Aligned Planarity Regularization
definition: A regularization technique that aligns depth-inferred, approximated surface normals with the gravity axis to promote local planarity, coupling adjacent rays via a corresponding surface approximation to facilitate cross-ray gradient flow.
summary: Gravity-Aligned Planarity Regularization enforces local surface planarity by aligning inferred normals with the gravity axis, reducing geometric artifacts on flat surfaces in satellite imagery.
